verdict.rationale: Anthropic's pricing docs publish a per-MTok table for every current model, covering base input, cache writes, cache hits and output, with no sales contact needed. The prices are mirrored on anthropic.com/pricing, and community posts quote public per-million-token prices (e.g. $5/$25), which corroborates that the rates are openly listed. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that every current model (not just flagship/Opus rows) is listed, and a check that the docs table and the marketing pricing page agree.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every current model without talking to sales

citations.quote: Pricing docs publish per-MTok prices for every current model without sales contact
Pricing is now $5/$25 per million [input/output] tokens.
